page.overview:
Who is Wiegraf Folles?

Wiegraf Folles is an antagonist in Final Fantasy Tactics. Leader of the Corpse Brigade revolutionary terrorist organization, he is a white knight, able to use most of the same swordsmanship abilities as holy knights, like Agrias Oaks. His sister, Milleuda, is also a member of the brigade.

In Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles, Wiegraf is given additional dialogue that expand on his backstory. In The War of the Lions version, he has an added scene.

Wiegraf was the commander of an army unit called the Dead Men, formed from among the peasantry during the Fifty Years' War. Upon returning home, the crippling monetary problems facing the country led to Wiegraf's soldiers being denied their pay. Developing a distaste for nobles, Wiegraf and his soldiers renamed themselves the "Corpse Brigade", beginning a campaign of ambushes against the remaining nobles and the Crown, which earned them notoriety and a reputation as anarchists.

Corpse Brigade proved a match for the orders of the Northern and Southern Skies knights, testament to Wiegraf's skill as a soldier and a commander. When his lieutenant, Gustav Margriff, defied his orders and kidnapped Marquis Elmdore of Limberry for ransom, Wiegraf executed him and released the marquis with no monetary demands after negotiating his escape with the knight cadets Ramza Beoulve, Delita Heiral, and Argath Thadalfus at the Sand Rat Sietch. Despite his grudge, Wiegraf's ultimate intention is to reform the way Ivalice is run, a goal not all of his underlings share.
